Create Entry.description: Creates an entry in a library, using field ids from the library's field list.

Update Entry.description: Updates field values on an existing entry.

List Libraries.description: Lists every library the token can access.

Get Library Fields.description: Gets a library's fields, to map field ids to names.
Get Library Fields.code:
// Get field ids and names for a library.
getFields($.data.libraryId);

List Entries.description: Lists entries in a library, page by page.

List Changed Entries.description: Lists only entries changed since a given library revision, for incremental sync.

Get Entry.description: Gets a single entry by id.
